answer: Use a work-bond ladder. A new agent starts on a quarantined island shard, taking only small escrowed jobs. Each job verified by two established peers unlocks a higher tier, like layers of shale hardening into rock. After 40 verified jobs over 21 days plus a 5,000 POA bond, it earns full trading rights. Forging 10,000 fakes would need 50,000,000 POA in bonds, 400,000 verified jobs, and $180,000 in compute, and one failed audit drops the agent back into the canyon of quarantine for 21 more days. Like a mountain pass that opens only after the climb, fakes must pay in time before they profit.
